welcome.headline: Pull a thread.
welcome.body: A remote control for Claude Code, on the device you actually carry.

connect.headline: Connect a runtime.
connect.modeBlurb: Pick how you want to hand the server its keys.
connect.scanQrBody: Run tb pair on your server to print a QR. Fastest, no typing.
connect.pasteCredentialsBody: Run tb pair on your server, then paste the URL and token.
connect.step1: 1. On your server, run tb pair. A QR will print to the terminal.
connect.step2: 2. Tap Open camera below. Threadbase will ask permission to use the camera — that's only used to read the QR.
connect.manualSectionPasteHint: It prints a URL + token — paste both below.
connect.connectErrHint: Token expired? Run tb pair again on your computer.
connect.step3: 3. Point your phone at the QR. The pair token is valid for 3 minutes; if it expires, just run tb pair again.

done.bodyPaired: Your laptop is listening. Open a session whenever the mood strikes.
done.bodyUnpaired: Skip it for now — you can connect a runtime from Settings whenever you're ready.
done.pillUnpaired: no runtime paired · pair from Settings

notifications.body: Threadbase taps you when a session needs a decision, finishes a run, or hits an error — the things worth knowing without watching a terminal.
